mathematical_result.name: QFORM-THREE-MESOSCOPIC-ROWS-NO-OVERSHOOT-v1
mathematical_result.statement: In the exact rank-three three-bank uniform-input family with one distinguished row of leverage ell_{j,m} and m equal diffuse rows of total leverage 1-ell_{j,m} in each bank, max_j ell_{j,m}->0 implies ||p_m||_inf=3sqrt2[1-sum_j c_j(u)D_{j,m}+o(sum_j D_{j,m})], where D_{j,m}=ell_{j,m}^2+(1-ell_{j,m})^2/m and c_j(u)=(57+6u_j^2-39u_j^4)/640 >=3/80.
mathematical_result.critical_scale: ell_{j,m}=alpha_j/sqrt(m) gives coefficient sum_j c_j(u)(1+alpha_j^2)/m; for the account04/B17 rational rotation the baseline sum is exactly 5295/21952, and every nonzero alpha strictly increases the deficit.
mathematical_result.continuity: proved only for this explicit finite family; full-target continuity remains open

partner_applied.use: weighted local Edgeworth/Fourier-tail estimates are applied to the actual mesoscopic bank characteristic function; the exact partner coefficient 5295/21952 is recovered and used in the critical-scale comparison inequality; partner witness supplies C_universal>=3sqrt2

unresolved_implication: The result is restricted to orthogonal three-bank product provenance with centered unit-interval inputs and one distinguished row per bank; it does not control order-one non-Gaussian components, non-collinear mesoscopic rows before aggregation, or arbitrary added spectrum.
next_step: Stress exact source-valid families with two or more non-collinear mesoscopic rows coupling before bank aggregation, or an order-one surviving non-Gaussian component, while preserving exact three-large-eigenvalue spectrum.
